items.title: 👁️ 英伟达叫停对东南亚四国 AI 服务器出货  英伟达已要求主要制造伙伴暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚发运 AI 服务器。

items.title_en: Nvidia halts AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
items.summary: Nvidia has reportedly told manufacturing partners to pause AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia amid new US export controls targeting China's access to advanced chips.
